lesson.title: The Evolution of the Internet
lesson.overview: This lesson explores the historical development of the internet, focusing on key milestones and technological advancements that have transformed how we connect, communicate, and share information. We will examine the origins of the internet, its evolution over the decades, and its impact on modern society.
lesson.previous_summary: In the previous lesson, we discussed the concept of internet culture, which encompasses the various ways people communicate and interact online. We explored components like memes, social media, and online communities, along with their historical context and societal impact.

sections.title: Origins of the Internet
sections.details: The internet began as ARPANET in 1969, created by the United States Department of Defense. It enabled different computers to communicate over a packet-switching network, laying the foundation for future developments.

sections.title: Development of Protocols
sections.details: In the 1970s, key protocols such as TCP/IP were developed, allowing diverse networks to interconnect and facilitating the growth of what we now recognize as the internet.

sections.title: The World Wide Web
sections.details: Tim Berners-Lee created the World Wide Web in 1989, revolutionizing access to information by introducing web browsers and hyperlinks, which made the internet more user-friendly.

sections.title: E-commerce and Social Media
sections.details: The late 1990s and early 2000s saw the rise of e-commerce with companies like Amazon and eBay, followed by the emergence of social media platforms such as Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube, drastically changing interpersonal interactions.

sections.title: Mobile Internet and Connectivity
sections.details: The advent of smartphones and mobile internet in the late 2000s allowed users to access the internet anytime and anywhere, leading to a significant shift in behavioral patterns and content consumption.

sections.title: Present and Future
sections.details: As of 2023, the internet continues to evolve with advancements in AI, IoT, and 5G technology, paving the way for a more interconnected world and raising new questions of privacy and ethics.

flashcards.definition: The precursor to the internet, developed in 1969 to enable communication between different computers.
A set of communication protocols used for interconnecting network devices on the internet.
A system of interlinked hypertext documents accessed via the internet, created by Tim Berners-Lee in 1989.
Commercial transactions conducted electronically on the internet.
The internet accessed via mobile devices, enabling connectivity on the go.

takeaways: The internet has evolved from a military communication network to a global platform affecting every aspect of human life.
Key technological milestones such as TCP/IP and the World Wide Web have revolutionized how we access and share information.
The rapid growth of mobile internet connectivity has changed consumption patterns and accessibility of content.
